name: gfx_detect
notes: adapter: 11h/12h/13h VGA-MCGA, 0Dh/0Fh/10h EGA, 07h/0Bh mono, 09h Tandy, 04h CGA

name: gfx_line_to
notes: line from pen, ends inclusive; h/v lines via gfx_fill_rect_clipped; pen := end

name: gfx_get_mode
notes: DS:BD49, or BIOS mode (INT 10h AH=0Fh) if negative

name: mouse_init
notes: INT 33h AX=0; sets BD46/BD47 and coordinate shifts BD4F/BD50; returns buttons or 0

name: mouse_set_range
type: int(int x0 int x1 int y0 int y1)

name: mouse_get
notes: INT 33h AX=3, unshifted, x clamped to width-1

name: text_exit_clear
notes: text mode only: DOS ESC[2J, clear page if cursor not at 0,0

name: gfx_set_copy_page
notes: 13h: BD43 = p, BD86 = BD8C[p]; source of 17eb; not a display select (hud.md: gfx_show_page)

name: gfx_set_visible_page
notes: 13h: swaps page table entries and contents; TD3 calls it once with 0 (no-op)

name: gfx_alloc_page
notes: 13h: DOS 48h FA0h paragraphs -> BD8C[p], zeroed; returns 0 / DOS error 7,8 / 1

name: gfx_set_pal_reg
type: int(int idx int a int b int c)
notes: dead module linked for CS 1758h; EGA/VGA attribute palette

name: gfx_set_display_offset
notes: CRTC start = y*80 + x/4 after vretrace (screen shake)

name: gfx_fill_rect
type: int(int x0 int x1 int y0 int y1)
notes: inclusive, unclipped, colour BD41, 13h bottom row first

name: gfx_copy_rect_to_copy_page
type: int(int x0 int x1 int y0 int y1)
notes: draw page -> copy page; no callers

name: gfx_copy_rect_from_copy_page
type: int(int x0 int x1 int y0 int y1)

name: gfx_copy_rect
type: int(int x0 int x1 int y0 int y1 int dx int dy_bottom int src int dst)
notes: page to page, rows bottom-up, dst y = bottom row

name: gfx_draw_bitmap
notes: 1bpp at pen, set bits = BD41, rows upward; 185f:01b4 (Tandy path) is overwritten by timer_install

name: gfx_read_bitmap
notes: 1bpp mask of pixels == BD41 at pen, rows upward

name: gfx_set_ega_palette
notes: EGA/Tandy/13h DAC 0-15; not called in the VGA build

name: gfx_set_mode
notes: mode 00..14h, <0 = adopt BIOS mode; mode*2 -> DS:BD44; TD3 VGA uses 13h (BIOS chain-4), 14h unused

name: gfx_fill_rect_clipped
type: int(int x0 int x1 int y0 int y1)

name: gfx_clear_page
notes: clears draw page (13h zero FA00h bytes)

name: joy_read_raw
notes: port 201h axes -> DS:00C2/00CC unless a tick occurred; returns (~port)&30h

name: text_draw_char
notes: proportional 8x8 glyph from CS:0262 + 8c; opaque bg unless DS:90E0

name: dos_seek
type: int(int fh u16 lo u16 hi)

name: dos_read
type: u16(void far *buf u16 n int fh)

name: dissolve_page1_to_0
notes: 64 steps (8x8 ordered), 1 per tick, abort on DS:008C

name: dissolve_poll
notes: rand(); if DS:009F get_key(&DS:90DA) else DS:008C = 0

name: dac_upload_256
notes: CS:0002[768] -> DAC, 32 colours per vblank sync

name: rle_draw_page
type: void(u8 *pairs int npairs int width int x int y_bottom)
notes: (colour+DS:90F0, count) runs into page DS:009A, bottom-up

name: kbd_isr
notes: INT 9: -> DS:915B key, DS:915C dir bits, DS:9153 ctrl; own lock/LED handling; no BIOS chain

name: timer_install
notes: PIT ch0 divisor 2000h (145.65 Hz), hooks INT 8; its DS:C5E4 store hits 185f:01b4 (DS = CS bug)

name: timer_restore
notes: PIT back to 18.2 Hz and old INT 8

name: timer_isr
notes: INT 8: snd_tick, DS:00A0++, chain old INT 8 every 8th tick

name: rect_save
type: void(int x0 int x1 int y0 int y1)
notes: page DS:009A rect -> DS:90D0 buffer (packed rows)

name: rect_restore
type: void(int x0 int x1 int y0 int y1)

name: view_present
notes: per race frame: mirror_present, then 3D buffer DS:90D0 -> page 0 with mirror hole

name: mirror_present
notes: waits vertical retrace; copies mirror DS:90D2 to screen x 168-255 rows 11-29

name: rle_draw_dither
type: void(u8 *pairs int npairs int width int x int y int cont)
notes: EGA/Tandy picture draw with error diffusion (not VGA)

name: print_text_bios
notes: INT 10h AH=2/9 text output (setup screen and fatal messages)

name: lzw_alloc
notes: DOS 48h 300h paragraphs -> DS:16B8, DS:E7DC far ptr; also the mirror buffer

name: lzw_decode
notes: LZW 9-12 bits, 100h clear, 101h end; sets DS:BD3F = 1

name: lzw_get_code
notes: next code with input window refill

name: skip_flag
notes: set by a key during dissolves/animations

name: page_cur
notes: page for the 0c1c drawers: 0 = screen (A000h), 1 = RAM page

name: lzw_bitpos
notes: bit position in the input window

name: scratch_key
notes: dissolve_poll key target / dither draw pointer

name: kbd_key
notes: last translated key code (readers clear it)

name: kbd_dirs
notes: held bits: 1 up 2 down 4 left 8 right 10h Enter 20h Space

name: gfx_page_seg
notes: page segments (13h: A000h + allocated RAM pages)

name: pit_divisor
notes: never written: timer_install's store goes to 0C1C:C5E4 = 185f:01b4; never read
